_comment: Keyword rules for compliance_scan.py. level: red = do not publish, amber = fix or qualify. rule = ID in references/compliance.md. Patterns are Python regular expressions, matched case-insensitively. Medibank can add rules here without touching code. level note = shown for awareness, does not change the verdict. qualifiable amber rules drop to note when the text contains one of the qualifiers.

rules.message: Price or premium mentioned (CN-2: no price quotes).
rules.fix: Remove the number. Say: 价格和保障以官网条款为准.

rules.message: Promotion or discount (reads as selling; CN-2).
rules.fix: Delete the offer. Describe the service, not a deal.

rules.message: Comparison with, or naming of, other insurers (CN-2).
rules.fix: Remove the comparison. Say: 每家保障不一样，建议看各家官网条款.

patterns: (我|小编|我们)(来|可以)?帮你(买|办|投保)
rules.message: Purchase or sign-up instruction inside 小红书 (CN-1, CN-2).
rules.fix: Point to the next step in words: 去学校官网搜 OSHC / Medibank 官网.

rules.message: Off-platform diversion: WeChat, QR code, phone or link (XHS-3).
rules.fix: Name the destination in words only.

patterns: 留下.{0,4}(手机|电话|微信|邮箱)
rules.fix: Delete. Never collect data through 小红书.

patterns: 第一(?![次天步周个年学期时眼印站件])
rules.message: Absolute term banned by 广告法 Art. 9(3) (CN-7).
rules.fix: Use a relative, factual phrase, or delete the intensifier.

patterns: 买了.{0,4}(就能|就可以).{0,4}(过签|下签|签证)
rules.message: Visa guarantee or claim that Medibank is required (AU-5, AU-6).
rules.fix: Say: OSHC 是学生签证的要求之一，具体以澳洲内政部官网为准；学生可以自己选择保险公司.

rules.message: Implies Medibank sells or operates in mainland China (CN-3).

patterns: 中介.{0,6}(坑|骗|黑心|回扣|割韭菜)
rules.message: Disparages education agents (ACL s 18 risk; legitimate channel partners).
rules.fix: Reframe positively: 中介可以帮你办，你自己也要看懂.
Describe what the service is, with 以条款为准.

rules.message: Claims to be unsponsored. If paid, this is misleading (XHS-1, AU-2).
rules.fix: Delete; paid notes go through 蒲公英 with the sponsor tag.

rules.message: 'Free / no out-of-pocket' needs the exact conditions (e.g. Online Doctor: trial, 16+, not dependants).
rules.fix: Add the conditions from brand-facts.md and 以官网条款为准.

rules.message: Specific benefit, percentage or waiting period: check against the current policy.
rules.fix: Confirm with Medibank and add 以官网条款为准.

rules.message: Mental-health topic: supportive tone, crisis info, no diagnosis.
rules.fix: Add: 紧急情况请拨打 000；也可以联系 Lifeline 13 11 14.

rules.message: Names a university: no implied endorsement unless a partnership exists.
rules.fix: Check the partnership (UNSW's preferred OSHC provider is Medibank) and keep wording factual.

rules.message: Visa topic: keep to 'OSHC is a visa condition, check Home Affairs'.
